Plays the specified sound by SoundKitID.
```
willPlay , soundHandle = PlaySound ( soundKitID [, channel , forceNoDuplicates , runFinishCallback ])
```

## Contents
* 1 Arguments
* 2 Returns
* 3 Example
* 4 Details
  + 4.1 Finding Sound IDs
* 5 Patch changes
* 6 See also

## Arguments
```
soundKitID
number \- Sound Kit ID in [SoundKitEntry.db2](https://wago.tools/db2/soundkitentry) . Sounds used in FrameXML are defined in the [SOUNDKIT](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/live/Interface/SharedXML/SoundKitConstants.lua) table.
```
channel
string ? `= SFX` - The sound channel.

...

| Channel | Toggle CVar | Volume CVar [[1]](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/10.0.0/Interface/SharedXML/SettingDefinitions/Audio.lua) |
| `Talking Head` [[2]](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/9.0.5/AddOns/Blizzard_TalkingHeadUI/Blizzard_TalkingHeadUI.lua) |  |  |
Volume sliders in the interface options
```
forceNoDuplicates
boolean ? `= true` \- Allows duplicate sounds if false.
```
runFinishCallback
boolean ? `= false` - Fires SOUNDKIT_FINISHED when the sound has finished playing, arg1 will be `soundHandle` .

## Returns
```
willPlay
boolean \- true if the sound will be played, nil otherwise (prevented by a muted sound channel, for instance).
```
soundHandle
number - identifier for the queued playback.

## Example
Plays the ready check sound file ( _sound/interface/levelup2.ogg_ )
```
PlaySound ( SOUNDKIT . READY_CHECK ) -- by SOUNDKIT key 
 PlaySound ( 8960 ) -- by SoundKitID
```
Copy
```
PlaySoundFile (567478) -- by FileDataID
```

...

## Patch changes
* Legion **Patch 7.3.0 (2017-08-29):** Changed. String-based input is not allowed. SoundKitID should be given while calling _PlaySound()_ . This change is more like a replacement for PlaySoundKitID .
* Legion **Patch 7.0.3 (2016-07-19):** Added fourth argument, `runFinishCallback` .
* Mists of Pandaria **Patch 5.0.4 (2012-08-28):** Added `willPlay` and `soundHandle` return values.
